svg.title: Vaani, the AI assistant on roydonsequeira.com
svg.desc: Vaani answers visitors' questions about my work on roydonsequeira.com. Its system prompt is built from the site's portfolio data, and the API key and prompt stay on the server. A sample exchange from the site: asked "What has Roydon shipped?", it answers: A WhatsApp agent that onboards customers from the very first message, Cortex, his own agent framework, and production medical AI at ReinHealth.ai.
